newsitem.title: USA: Spire shareholders approve share increase.
newsitem.headline: Spire shareholders approve share increase.

text.p: Spire Corp said Wendesday its stockholders voted to increase the number of authorized shares of common stock and to authorize the creation of three new wholly owned subsidiaries.
Stockholders at the annual meeting voted to increase the number of authorized shares of common stock from six million to 20 million shares. Spire had 3,020,700 shares outstanding as of December 31.

Stockholders, said Spire, also voted to restructure the corporation by moving a substantial portion of its assets into wholly owned subsidiaries, to facilitate financing and other activities. The new subsidiaries would be Spire Biomaterials Inc, Spire Optoelectronics Inc and Spire Photovoltaics Inc.
